title: Spicy Katsuobushi Paratha
description: A crispy and spicy Indian-inspired paratha dish topped with umami-rich katsuobushi.

ingredients.name: tender mustard greens
ingredients.notes: or substitute with similar leafy greens

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Brush the paratha with olive oil on both sides.
Place the paratha in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden.
Heat the katsuobushi in a small pan over low heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the chopped mustard greens, grated ginger, and cayenne pepper to the pan with the katsuobushi.
Stir-fry the greens until wilted, then season with salt to taste.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked paratha on a plate and top with the spicy greens mixture.
